recreation.gov search API 2026-11-20 (name search and a 5-mile radius around the pin): no Crystal Creek facility -> first-come only

Esri World Imagery 2026-11-20 (220 m and 100 m half-width): a gravel loop under scattered conifers NE of the entrance spur, bounded on the north by a ~12-15 m-wide channel; the loop's west end and NW spur sit ~13-20 m from that channel over grass and shrubs; the wider Gros Ventre channel (~25-30 m) and a gravel bar lie beyond; the entrance spur runs down to the river bank at the stored pin (43.61072,-110.43113), ~40 m from the FS point and ~120 m from the loop's middle

note: Small Bridger-Teton NF campground where Crystal Creek meets the Gros Ventre River, about 27 miles from Jackson by way of Kelly and the gravel Gros Ventre River Road (FR 30400). The river is eating the bank: take care near the edge. --Claude

Sites, facilities, booking, fees, season written. Riverview holds with a creekside lead. Pin good. Phone empty -> 307-739-5400. Note cleaned.
